name: ES2004d
method: keypoints = AMI abstractive annotation (decisions, actions, problems, abstract sentences) mapped to keyword groups and spans by Claude (Opus); questions written by Claude from the gold transcript

keypoints.text: The Industrial Designer presented the prototype and discussed its look, its internal components, and its interface.
The Marketing Expert evaluated the product according to the initial product goals.
The Project Manager presented the final cost of the device which exceeded the initial projected price point.
The group decided to remove speech recognition when the project exceeded its initial budget.
All members felt that they interacted well and that they felt they could be creative.
The Marketing Expert felt that the market-research based approach would help the project's success with consumers.
The group did express, however, that the budget was overly constraining.
The group will suggest to the management that speech recognition remain in the product design.
All members will fill out a final evaluation questionnaire.
It was decided that the speech recognition component seemed feasible, so it was added to the prototype design to provide a device locator function.
The plastic case will be a neutral color.
The changeable rubber cases will be available in vibrant, fruit colors.
The LCD screen will appear only in black and white.
The company logo will appear on the inside of the device when opened.
The group decided that the device fulfilled enough of the project's initial goals to continue in production.
There was a lack of cost information at the beginning of the project; the prototype design may have been different had this information been available at the beginning.

questions.q: In the final remote control design meeting, what type of power source had the team decided to use?
In the remote control prototype presentation, what would the remote say when someone shouts asking where it is?
In the remote control prototype, how many circuit boards were needed and why?
questions.answer: Two separate PCBs, because the device is split over two layers joined at the hinge.

questions.q: In the remote control evaluation, what rating scale did the marketing expert use for the criteria?
questions.answer: A seven-point scale where one is true and seven is false.

questions.q: In the remote control prototype evaluation, which criterion got the weakest rating, and what was its average?
questions.answer: Minimising repetitive strain injury (RSI), averaging about 4.25.

questions.q: In the remote control finance discussion, what did the unit cost come to after taking out voice recognition?
questions.answer: About 12.25 euros, within the 12.5 euro budget.

questions.q: In the remote control team's project review, which communication tool did they say they would have used more if they had more time?
